inputs.name: join
inputs.description: Join the hosts to the tailnet with auth_key. When false, the circuit installs Tailscale and leaves the hosts logged out.

inputs.name: auth_key
inputs.description: Tailscale auth key the hosts join the tailnet with, such as tskey-auth-.... Required when join is true.

inputs.name: hostname
inputs.description: Name for the node in the tailnet. When null, Tailscale uses the host's name. Meant for a single host: every host gets the same name.

inputs.name: advertise_routes
inputs.description: Subnets to offer the tailnet as a subnet router, such as ["192.168.1.0/24"]. Turns on IP forwarding.

inputs.name: advertise_exit_node
inputs.description: Offer the hosts as exit nodes. Turns on IP forwarding.

inputs.name: accept_routes
inputs.description: Use subnet routes other nodes advertise.

inputs.name: ssh
inputs.description: Run Tailscale SSH, so the tailnet's access rules decide who can log in over SSH from the tailnet.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: ACL tags to advertise when joining, such as ["tag:server"]. The auth key must be allowed to apply them.

inputs.name: extra_args
inputs.description: More flags for tailscale up, such as ["--shields-up"]. Used only when joining.
